name: MithrilUI
$comment: The one skin. There used to be Dark / Full / Tuned variants; they are
folded in here, because three entries in a dropdown to pick between
shades of the same idea is not a feature.
Build for your own resolution, or the toolbar lands in the wrong place:
TWO THINGS THIS COSTS YOU, both inherent to skinning rather than choices:
1. sweepCatchAll clears the ~409 assets no named rule recognises. That is
what removes the gold minimap rim and the last of the filigree. It is
also unverifiable: if something you wanted disappears, it came from
here, and the fix is to give that asset its own exclusion.
2. toolbar-align writes explicit positions, so the game's own layout tool
(Ctrl+backslash) can no longer move the toolbar. There is no way to
straighten elements without fixing them in place.

$mapArrow: The map player marker is left to the client on purpose, see
skin/assets.json. Two panels rotate that one asset from different zero
headings, so no single drawn orientation is correct on both.
options.$toolbar: Widths are generous: too wide only adds empty space, too narrow clips buttons.
$outliers: Three things break the button row regardless of where the slots go:
the store button (drawn larger and higher than everything around it),
the action bar page switcher, and a small chevron. The first two have
element IDs and are handled here. The chevron does not, and needs an
pageSwitcherX is measured from the left edge of the toolbar strip.
$vitals: Big, square morale and power bars. The stock ones are sized for a 2007
screen and read as slivers at 1440p.
They are rectangles already; the round look came from the carved frame
around them, which the sweep clears. So size is the only thing left to
set, and vitalBarHeight is the number that makes them feel ElvUI-ish.
vitalBarLeft is the gap that leaves room for the portrait. If the bars
overlap it or float too far right, that is the number to change.
